roles.title: Director-General

details.imageSource: Hansenne, 1 March 1989, ILO Historical Archives, photographer J. Maillard
details.summary: Belgian politician and eighth Director-General of the International Labour Office of the International Labour Organization (ILO) 1989-1999
details.life: Was born on 23 March 1940 in Rotheux-Rimière, Belgium. He is the son of Edgard Hansenne, metalworker, and Georgette Charlier, secretary. In 1978 he married Gabrielle van Landschoot. They have one daughter and one son.
details.editors: Bob Reinalda, Kent J. Kille and Jaci L. Eisenberg
